# ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops Daily Update (May 28, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's focus was on Superchain migration tasks, including updating prestate for Cannon64, marking several Sepolia migration tasks as executed, and enhancing the FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate with an optional L2 ProxyAdmin owner pre-flight check.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Superchain Migration Task Updates
Several migration tasks for Sepolia were updated and marked as executed. This included updating the status of SOP-1 tasks 082-085 from DRAFT to EXECUTED, with links to their respective Etherscan transactions. Additionally, U19 betanet tasks 076-079 were marked as EXECUTED, linking to their on-chain Sepolia transactions. Tasks 80 and 81 were canceled as stale, and receiving infra addresses were updated for other migration tasks. [#1437](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1437), [#1435](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1435), [#1434](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1434)

### Cannon64 Prestate Update
The prestate for op-program/v1.9.0-rc.1 Cannon64 (multichain build) was updated for both FDG (game type 0) and PDG (game type 1) `gameArgs` in migration SOP-1 task 084. This embeds the freshly-built Cannon64 absolute prestate `0x032ab5ac33a98dc99947c`. [#1436](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1436)

### FeeVault Upgrade Template Enhancement
An optional L2 ProxyAdmin owner pre-flight check was added to the `FeeVaultUpgradeTemplate`. This new feature is gated by an `l2RpcUrls` TOML field and aims to catch failure modes where the L1 Safe transaction executes successfully but the L2 `upgradeAndCall` fails. [#1438](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/pull/1438)

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
No new pull requests were opened today.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### FinalizedL2 Resolution Bug Fixed
The issue where `optimism_syncStatus.finalized_l2` could briefly revert to genesis during interop activation has been fixed. This bug, which caused a temporary snap back to block 0 before recovery, was resolved by a recent pull request. [#20365](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20365)

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were reported today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Flaky Test: `TestFollowL2_WithoutCLP2P`
The `TestFollowL2_WithoutCLP2P` test continues to be flaky, with a recent failure on develop. The latest CI run on May 28, 2026, reported an error: "operation failed permanently after 20 attempts: expected head to advance: local-safe". This indicates an issue with the L2 head not advancing as expected during the test. [#20718](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20718)

### Proofs: Increase `MAX_CLOCK_DURATION` and Reduce Air Gap Constants
Discussion continues on adjusting `MAX_CLOCK_DURATION` and reducing air gap constants for faster withdrawals with ZK proofs, while maintaining a 7-day total. A key challenge is that finality and proof maturity delays are constant and shared across chains, preventing reduction for ZK and 1-day withdrawals if other chains still use fault proofs. The latest comment suggests running numbers to assess the effects of changes on the maximum history needed. [#20774](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/20774)

### `op-revm` Support and Syncing
The community is seeking clarification on the syncing strategy for `op-revm` following its transfer to the `ethereum-optimism` repository. The team aims to stay in sync with new `revm` releases, though a formalized cadence is not yet established. Updates to `reth` dependencies, which occur periodically, are seen as good opportunities to also update shared dependencies like `revm` and `alloy` crates. The latest comment confirms that `cargo` already resolves `alloy` crates to those specified by `reth`, and the manifest will be updated to reflect actual versions in use. [#21069](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21069)

### `op-supernode`/`op-reth`: CL Sync Recovery Stalling
The issue of CL sync recovery stalling when `SafeDB`/bookkeeping references an EL-missing block is being actively investigated. The latest observations from SN3 indicate that while `unsafe/latest` can progress, `safe/finalized` remain pinned, leading to FCU timeouts. A detailed analysis suggests two distinct bugs: `op-node` advancing `localSafeHead` despite FCU timeouts, and `op-reth`'s engine actor stopping mid-canonicalization. The current working hypothesis points to an empty verified DB on supernode restart, causing the `SuperAuthority` to return an activation anchor, and a long consensus-layer `FindL2Heads` startup walkback for a dependency chain. A potential mitigation involves testing a supernode-only DB reset/restart with the per-chain sync mode set to `execution-layer` to avoid the large CL startup walkback. [#21076](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/issues/21076)
